name: Jokalala Java Pack
description: High-signal Java security rules (Tier-1 surface engine)

rules.name: Runtime.exec with concatenated command
rules.message: Concatenating input into an exec command enables injection
rules.recommendation: Use ProcessBuilder with a fixed argument list; validate inputs

rules.name: SQL executed with string concatenation
rules.message: Concatenating values into SQL enables injection
rules.recommendation: Use PreparedStatement with ? placeholders and setString/setInt

rules.name: XML external entities explicitly enabled
rules.message: Enabling external entity processing allows XXE attacks
rules.recommendation: Disable DTDs/external entities on the parser factory

rules.name: Java native deserialization
rules.message: Deserializing untrusted data can execute gadget chains
rules.recommendation: Avoid native serialization; use JSON with strict types or an ObjectInputFilter
rules.owaspCategory: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures

rules.name: Weak MessageDigest (MD5/SHA-1)
rules.message: MD5/SHA-1 are broken for security purposes
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger; for passwords use bcrypt/argon2

rules.name: Weak cipher or ECB mode
rules.recommendation: Use AES/GCM/NoPadding with a random IV per message

rules.name: java.util.Random used for a security value
rules.message: java.util.Random is predictable; unsuitable for secrets
rules.recommendation: Use SecureRandom for tokens and keys

rules.name: Empty checkServerTrusted (trust-all TrustManager)
rules.message: An empty trust check accepts any certificate, enabling MITM
rules.recommendation: Use the platform trust store or pin specific certificates

rules.name: Hostname verification disabled
rules.message: Disabling hostname verification enables MITM even with valid certs

rules.name: JNDI lookup expression (${jndi:...})
rules.message: JNDI lookup strings enable remote code loading (Log4Shell pattern)
rules.recommendation: Never construct JNDI lookups from input; upgrade logging libraries
